title: kmx.io blog : KC3 v0.1.17 released
content_html:
2026-08-02 20:44:18

KC3 v0.1.17 was released today.

  • https://github.com/kc3-lang/kc3/releases/tag/v0.1.17
  • https://git.kmx.io/kc3-lang/kc3/_tree/v0.1.17

New in this release :

  • libkc3

    • copying temporary variables for pthread_mutex and pthread_rwlock would cause undefined behaviour as per POSIX, this fixes pthread on macOS
    • allow for log hooks (a C function callback with a user pointer) in the facts database
    • incremental compilation with cached parser results in .kc3c files, like Python does. Gives 5x faster loading times for all .kc3 files. env_load automatically handles this.
    • fixed a bug in ht_iterator_next where the iterator would not go through the first collision list
    • database logging now supports and defaults to binary format (marshall + marshall_read)
    • fixed marshall + marshall_read hash table usage
    • str: fixed display of floating point numbers

  • Facts

    • Facts.connect/accept allows for bi-directional synchronization of an existing Facts.database() over a TLS encrypted connection after a successful HMAC-SHA256 shared secret authentication challenge/response
    • Facts.accept accepts connections one by one
    • Facts.acceptor_loop starts a thread that calls accept() in a loop
    • Facts.acceptor_loop_join() stops the acceptor loop cleanly
    • Fixed hash table lookup in marshall reducing every dump by 30%

  • HTTPd

    • allow for configuration of unveil paths in config/unveil.kc3
    • allow for custom log messages in error and request log

  • HTTPS

    • HTTPS.Client with libtls and automatic or manual connection
      • GET method
      • POST method
      • JSON response

  • JSON

    • fixed parser
      • boolean true or false → Bool
      • map {"key", "value"} → Map %{"key" => "value"}
      • array [1, 2, 3] → List [1, 2, 3]

  • RUsage

    • current-process statistics for user and system CPU time, current and maximum resident memory, virtual memory, and open files
    • RUsage.stats() returns all statistics in a single map

KC3 v0.1.17 今天发布。

  • https://github.com/kc3-lang/kc3/releases/tag/v0.1.17
  • https://git.kmx.io/kc3-lang/kc3/_tree/v0.1.17

此版本中的新功能：

  • libkc3 复制 pthread_mutex 和 pthread_rwlock 的临时变量将导致按照 POSIX 的未定义行为，这修复了 macOS 上的 pthread 允许在事实数据库增量编译中使用缓存的解析器结果进行日志挂钩（带有用户指针的 C 函数回调），就像 Python 一样。 所有 .kc3 文件的加载速度加快 5 倍。 env_load 自动处理这个问题。 修复了 ht_iterator_next 中迭代器不会遍历第一个冲突列表的错误 数据库日志记录现在支持并默认为二进制格式 (marshall + marshall_read) 修复了 marshall + marshall_read 哈希表用法 str：修复了浮点数的显示
  • Facts Facts.connect/accept 允许在成功 HMAC-SHA256 共享秘密身份验证质询/响应后通过 TLS 加密连接对现有 Facts.database() 进行双向同步 Facts.accept 逐一接受连接 Facts.acceptor_loop 启动一个在循环中调用 accept() 的线程 Facts.acceptor_loop_join() 干净地停止接受器循环 修复了 marshall 中的哈希表查找，减少了每次转储30%
  • HTTPd 允许在 config/unveil.kc3 中配置揭幕路径，允许在错误和请求日志中自定义日志消息
  • HTTPS HTTPS.Client 带有 libtls 和自动或手动连接 GET 方法 POST 方法 JSON 响应
  • JSON 固定解析器布尔 true 或 false → Bool map {"key", "value"} → Map %{"key" => "value"} 数组 [1, 2, 3] → List [1, 2, 3]
  • RUsage 当前进程的用户和系统 CPU 时间、当前和最大驻留内存、虚拟内存和打开文件的统计信息 RUsage.stats() 在单个映射中返回所有统计信息
